images.caption: Schematic diagram of neighborhood of the Trayvon Martin shooting.  Map was drawn freehand, roughly based on aerial photos hosted by Bing and Google, to avoid copyright entanglements) Red dots, from left to right, mark a) the 7/11 to which he went, b) the entrance to the gated community where he was challenged by Zimmerman, c) the home of Brandi Green at 2631 Retreat View Circle where he and his father were staying.  Yellow dots mark the locations of 911 calls by Zimmerman from 10/23/9 to 2/26/12, with the cluster at the lower left of the development marking his home at 1950 Retreat View Circle (except for two distant calls, 20093072260 and 20113441622).
